decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of powerful spells and artifact manipulation. By using cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and counterspells, the player aims to disrupt their opponent's plans while setting up their own win condition. The deck also utilizes artifacts such as Moxen and Time Vault to generate mana advantage and create a powerful board presence. With card draw spells like Brainstorm and Dig Through Time, the player can dig for key pieces and maintain card advantage to outpace their opponent.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of card advantage, disruption, and powerful win conditions. By utilizing powerful tutors and draw spells, the pilot can search for key pieces like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk to gain advantage. The deck also includes powerful disruption in the form of counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm. The win condition of the deck revolves around using Tinker to fetch Blightsteel Colossus or assembling the Time Vault + Bolas's Citadel combo for a quick victory. The deck also includes stax elements with cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade to disrupt opponents' strategies.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 aggro fish deck is focused on disrupting the opponent while maintaining a strong board presence. The deck includes powerful cards like Ancestral Recall and Black Lotus for card advantage and ramp, along with disruptive creatures like Tarmogoyf and Collector Ouphe. Control elements like Force of Will and Flusterstorm help protect your creatures and disrupt your opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils and Oko, Thief of Crowns to further control the game. Energy Flux is included to disrupt artifact-heavy strategies.

This deck relies on using cards like Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to quickly build a win condition, while also utilizing powerful spells like Time Walk, Ancestral Recall, and Force of Will to control the game. The deck is centered around efficient combo plays and disruption, allowing the player to quickly assemble their win condition and protect it from opposing threats. It also includes cards like Dark Ritual and Demonic Tutor to quickly find important pieces of the combo. Overall, the deck aims to win the game quickly and decisively through its powerful combo interactions.

The deck focuses on using artifacts to generate mana and draw cards, while also protecting itself with counterspells. The goal is to assemble a combo using cards like Paradoxical Outcome and bounce key artifacts like Mox Opal and Mana Vault to generate a large amount of mana and draw cards, eventually leading to a win condition through Karn, the Great Creator's ability or Bolas's Citadel. The deck utilizes powerful restricted cards like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk to gain an advantage and push towards victory quickly.

This deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing graveyard recursion and powerful creatures like Hogaak, Vengevine, and Hollow One to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Vigor and Chalice of the Void to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With the help of cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Stitcher's Supplier, the deck aims to quickly fill up the graveyard and bring back key threats to apply constant pressure on the opponent. The deck's blend of speed, resilience, and disruption makes it a formidable force in Vintage 1 vs 1 play.

The core principle of this Vintage 1 vs 1 Bazaar Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Basking Rootwalla, Blazing Rootwalla, and Hollow One, while utilizing graveyard recursion with cards like Master of Death and Squee, Goblin Nabob to consistently bring back threats like Vengevine. The deck also includes a disruptive suite of free counter spells like Force of Negation, Force of Vigor, and Force of Will to protect its game plan, along with graveyard hate like Mindbreak Trap and artifact removal like Force of Vigor. The deck also utilizes powerful card selection tools like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to help find its key threats quickly.

The deck focuses on controlling the game with counter spells, card draw, and disruptive creatures like Hullbreacher and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up powerful combos like Bolas's Citadel and Yawgmoth's Will. The deck includes key artifacts like Time Vault and Sol Ring to generate mana advantage and can utilize Narset, Parter of Veils to further disrupt the opponent's resources. With a mix of powerful draw spells, removal, and disruptive elements, Grixis Control aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent in the long game.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful Planeswalker cards like Narset, Oko, and Wrenn and Six to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also includes disruptive creatures like Collector Ouphe and Deathrite Shaman to slow down the opponent's resources. The deck includes a mix of card draw, counterspells, and removal spells to control the pace of the game. The mana base is designed to support the deck's colors and allow for flexibility in casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to out-value and out-tempo the opponent through efficient control strategies.

The deck focuses on using powerful planeswalkers and efficient control spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage. By utilizing cards like Dack Fayden, Oko, Thief of Crowns, and Wrenn and Six, the deck can control the board and manipulate resources to gain an advantage. The inclusion of cards like Force of Will, Assassin's Trophy, and Counterspells allows the deck to interact with the opponent's spells and threats effectively. The mana base is well-structured to support the deck's strategy while providing access to all necessary colors of mana.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the graveyard as a resource to quickly fill it with key creatures like Golgari Grave-Troll and Ichorid, triggering powerful abilities such as bringing back creatures from the graveyard and creating zombie tokens. The deck focuses on getting cards into the graveyard quickly through cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Cabal Therapy and Force of Will. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and explosive graveyard-based strategy.

The deck focuses on generating a high amount of mana through artifact acceleration, utilizing cards like Moxen and Urza's Saga. It aims to control the game with counterspells like Force of Will and Mental Misstep, while also digging through the deck with draw spells such as Ponder and Dig Through Time. The key strategy involves using Paradoxical Outcome to bounce back a large number of artifacts, generating more mana and card advantage. The deck also has interaction with the opponent's artifacts through Karn, the Great Creator and Hurkyl's Recall.

The deck focuses on using Doomsday to stack the perfect pile of cards needed to win the game, often using Demonic Tutor and various cantrips to set up the combo. The deck utilizes a high amount of counterspells and disruption to protect the combo while also including powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Gush to help dig for important pieces. The mana base is streamlined for consistency and includes powerful artifacts like Black Lotus to help accelerate the deck's game plan.

The deck focuses on playing disruptive creatures such as Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria to slow down the opponent while also using hate cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Vigor to disrupt their strategy. It also aims to pressure the opponent with aggressive creatures like Luminarch Aspirant and Outland Liberator, while utilizing powerful equipment like Sword of Fire and Ice and Batterskull to enhance their board presence. The deck's mana base is focused on providing consistent colored mana sources to allow for the successful casting of its disruptive creatures and spells.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with various lock pieces like Sphere of Resistance, Thorn of Amethyst, and Trinisphere, while also ramping into powerful threats like Golos, Tireless Pilgrim and Karn, the Great Creator. The deck aims to control the game by using cards like Crucible of Worlds and Wasteland to deny the opponent resources, and locking them out with cards like Ensnaring Bridge and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale. Additionally, the deck can utilize Mystic Forge and Inventors' Fair to search for key artifacts and close out the game.

This deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Basking Rootwalla, Bloodghast, and Hogaak, while utilizing graveyard synergies with cards like Vengevine and Hollow One. The strategic use of cards like Force of Vigor and Deathrite Shaman gives the deck additional versatility and disruption capabilities. The inclusion of powerful mana accelerants like Black Lotus and Moxen allows for explosive starts, supported by consistent card selection with Once Upon a Time and Bazaar of Baghdad. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to support its aggressive game plan while also disrupting the opponent's resources.
